ruleContent.replaceRegex:
<js>
result = result.replace(/.*\n/,"").replace(/.*\n/,"").replace(/\s*[（|(]本章完[)|）]\s*/,"");

if (title.length < 5) { result = result.replace(new RegExp(`\\s+?${title}\\n`),"") } 
else { result = result.replace(new RegExp(`\\s+?${title.substr(0,title.length*2/3)}.*\\n`),"") }

result.replace(new RegExp(`\\s+?第\\S+?章.{0,${title.length}}\\n`),"");
</js>

ruleSearch.bookList:
<js>
let option = {
    "charset": "gbk",
    "method": "POST",
    "body": `searchkey=${java.get("searchkey")}&submit=Search`,
    "headers": JSON.stringify({"Cookie": java.getCookie(baseUrl)})
};

let isVerified = result.includes("Just a moment...") || result.includes("onloadTurnstileCallback");
let isTooFast = result.includes("搜索的间隔时间");

if (isVerified) {
    java.toast("❗身份验证过期");
    let freshUrl = `${baseUrl}${baseUrl.includes('?') ? '&' : '?'}_t=${Date.now()}`;
    java.startBrowserAwait(freshUrl, "Authentication");
    result = java.ajax(`${baseUrl},${JSON.stringify(option)}`);
} else if (isTooFast) {
    java.toast("❗搜索过于频繁");
    Packages.java.lang.Thread.sleep(5000);
    result = java.ajax(`${baseUrl},${JSON.stringify(option)}`);
} else {
    result = result;
}
</js>
